dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to the Shoal's Haven! Our catches are fresh as can be, and our delicacies? Hoo, they're not to be missed!

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: I promise you these'll be the freshest fish you've ever tasted!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me you're selling fish that were caught yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: Hmm? Come again? I couldn't hear you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me you're selling fish that were caught yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: That little rascal... I was wondering why we weren't making as much as we ought to. Turns out Lawaia's been up to no good... I guess I'm going to have to let him go.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: You truly are an honest soul. If only there were more people like you out there, business wouldn't be such a cutthroat venture. Here, take this. It's a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me your fish are the freshest in town.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: Haha, that kid knows his stuff. Guess I made the right choice hiring him.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: And judging by how you chose to eat with us, it seems like you know your stuff as well. Here you go, these are for you.
